findings.whatWasWrong: filing-instructions.md sentence 3 read "The committed route record identifies no fee-waiver treatment for this certification." The record says the opposite and carries the point as a release blocker whose affectedElement is participant_instructions.
findings.whatIsThereNow: That sentence is deleted. filing-instructions.md now interpolates track.rules.feeWaiver verbatim: "AOC-RU-009 refers on its face to an exemption of fees if applicable. The criteria are not published and are recorded as an open question."
findings.carriedIntoParticipantInstructions: A new section, "What it costs, and the exemption question", prints track.rules.fees and track.rules.feeWaiver verbatim; the form's own sentence "I have provided the basic information necessary to qualify for record processing and exemption of fees - if applicable."; and the release blocker's own unanswered question, interpolated from releaseBlockers[].provenance.counselQuestion: "Does the AOC Records Unit waive or reduce the $40 expungement certification fee on indigency, and what does the participant have to supply to ask?"
findings.theOpenQuestionWasNotResolved: The packet states no waiver criterion and names no channel for asking, because the record publishes neither. It says in terms that it does not tell the participant who qualifies or how to ask, because the controlling record does not.
findings.whatItTellsThemToDoMeanwhile: Treat the $40 as payable, grounded on the form's own printed fee sentence, which warns that failure to comply results in the request being returned unprocessed. That is the issuer speaking, not a LegalEase conclusion about indigency.

findings.whatWasWrong: The record declares three selfHelpStopConditions; the packet carried none, and had no stop section at all.
findings.whatIsThereNow: A "## Stop and get help" section in participant-instructions.md, modelled on il-cannabis-vacate-set, printing all three conditions verbatim from track.selfHelpStopConditions.
perCondition: (a) adverse certification, participant wants to file anyway -- printed verbatim, with the record's own packetInstructions reason attached beneath it: "An adverse certification is advisory. The Clerks' Manual directs the clerk to file the petition regardless; the judge decides eligibility."

(b) certification lists convictions that are not theirs or are wrong -- printed verbatim, with the issuer's clerical-correction channel quoted from the form's own page text: "If you suspect information contained on the record is incorrect, please contact the Records Unit at (502) 573-1682 or (800) 928-6381." The two are kept distinct: the channel is presented as the AOC's route for a record believed wrong, and the record's listing of this as a stop-and-get-help point is stated separately. The packet does not claim the phone call resolves the stop condition.
(c) the 30-day filing window has run -- printed verbatim, with nothing added. The record prescribes no remedy and this lane invented none.
findings.processingTimeExpectationAdded: The Timing section now also prints track.postGenerationHandoffs[0] verbatim: "Processing takes roughly four to five months. The packet waits on the certification; the participant is told to expect that and is reminded when the 30-day filing window opens." It sits directly beneath the 30-day sentence, which is the gap VF49 named.
